text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses land use and land use change (LULUC) predictions from external global economic models—GTAP and LEITAP—as inputs to assess environmental consequences of shifting dairy systems in France. While the study includes national-scale context (France), its primary objective is not LULC prediction but rather consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) of grass-based vs. maize silage-based milk. The LULC changes are derived from pre-existing model outputs (Edwards et al., 2010) and applied indirectly; the paper does not implement its own spatial LULC modeling, generate mapped projections, or evaluate accuracy metrics. It considers multiple scenarios via different economic models but does not develop or compare ≥2 internally modeled future LULC scenarios with spatially explicit outputs. Thus, LULC prediction is used as an input step, not the central focus.)
